newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.03 down at 41.17 rupees to the dollar on Saturday in the kerb on improved demand for the U.S. currency and dealers said they expected the rupee to slide further in the near term.
"Trading remained volatile and the dollar strengthened on improved demand," dealer Owais Kalia said. "The rupee will slide against the dollar in the next few weeks."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended down at 2.80 percent from 2.90 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
